ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19

2. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 21

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 30
   C. 42
   D. 21

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 2/2
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

5. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 36

6. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 24
   C. 2
   D. 10

7. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 156

9. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 28
   C. 11
   D. 29

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 34
   C. 22
   D. 66

11. Solve for x: x + 5 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 8
   C. 12
   D. 7

12. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 16
   C. 17
   D. 8

13. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

14. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 65
   C. 16
   D. 0

15. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

16. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 8
   C. 64
   D. 32

17. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

18. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 29

19. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 14
   C. 10
   D. 2

20. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x = 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x > 5

21. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.6
   C. 27.7
   D. 27

22. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

23. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 37
   C. 5
   D. 36

24. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 122
   C. 22
   D. 121

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
